nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a field of characteristic $p$ (with $p = 0$ in characteristic zero) and let $f \in K[x]$ be irreducible. Then there exist $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and an irreducible separable polynomial $g \in K[x]$ such that $f(x) = g(x^{p^n})$, where $0^0 = 1$.
nodes.title: Irreducible polynomials are expansions of separable irreducibles

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a field of characteristic $p$ (with $p = 0$ in characteristic zero, and $0^0 = 1$) and let $f \in K[x]$ be irreducible. Then there exist $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and an irreducible separable polynomial $g \in K[x]$ with $f(x) = g(x^{p^n})$, and for every $n' \in \mathbb{N}$ and every irreducible separable polynomial $g' \in K[x]$ with $f(x) = g'(x^{p^{n'}})$ we have $n' = n$ and $g' = g$.
nodes.title: Irreducible polynomials are uniquely expansions of separable irreducibles

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a field of characteristic $p$ (with $p = 0$ in characteristic zero) and let $f \in K[x]$ be irreducible. If $n_1, n_2 \in \mathbb{N}$ and irreducible separable polynomials $g_1, g_2 \in K[x]$ satisfy $f(x) = g_1(x^{p^{n_1}})$ and $f(x) = g_2(x^{p^{n_2}})$, where $0^0 = 1$, then $n_1 = n_2$ and $g_1 = g_2$.
nodes.title: The separable irreducible underlying an irreducible polynomial is unique

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
